headline: Second readings of policies on harassment, hazing, and bullying and on electronic communications between employees and students.
summary: The agenda includes a closed executive session, a student presentation, and a monthly financial update. It also covers two policies for second reading, an action item on Monitoring Report 2.3, and consent agenda payments and bids for snow removal, salting, rubbish, and recycling.
items: Executive session (closed to public) on employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Focus on student learning: student representative report and South Burlington High School student presentation on The International Student Exchange Program (TIE)
Discussion: Policy F4 Investigation and Response to Harassment, Hazing, and Bullying of Students (second reading)
Discussion: Policy D9 Electronic Communications Between Employees and Students (second reading)
Discussion: The Other Paper article production process
Discussion: Act 170 Merger Committee report from October 20 first meeting
Action: Monitoring Report 2.3 Treatment of Community (Joe Clark)
Superintendent's report: meet the SPARC consultants on strategic plan

Consent agenda: payment orders #1172 ($777.88), #1173 ($2,165.43), #1174 ($3,649.63), and #1175 ($243,117.08); bid recommendations for snow removal and salting and for rubbish and recycling; set November 4, 2026 agenda; review future agenda items and parking lot
location: South Burlington School District, 577 Dorset Street
